name: Juiced
description: Lead-distribution platform for lead-gen businesses. It routes each inbound lead in real time to the right buyer (SMS, email, or straight into the buyer's CRM). Waterfall logic covers prepaid partner quotas, direct auction to the highest bid, a reverse-auction marketplace for "fresh" and then "aged" leads, and round-robin leftovers. Target: lead-gen pros and agencies generating $1M+/month (founder-stated). Founded Feb 2024, US.

mentions.evidence: ~$9,750 MRR, 13 active subscriptions, ~$10,251 L30, ~$160,810 all-time, L30 MRR growth +5.4%. Revenue synced Oct 6, 2026 ~04:39 Warsaw (02:39 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Lead routing + resale for one EU vertical where lead-gen is fragmented (PL solar/heat pumps, "Czyste Powietrze" grant leads, insurance comparison). Price per seat + per routed lead. Ping-post integrations with the buyers' CRMs are the moat.

whyItPrints: Plumbing for the pay-per-lead industry (verticals not named on TrustMRR; the homepage demo shows a "Wellness Subscriber" lead). Whoever routes the leads controls the money, and switching routers mid-campaign is painful. 13 customers paying ~$750/mo each on average (my calculation from MRR ÷ subs).
whyThisMatters:
Juiced takes a lead you already paid to generate and sends it to a buyer. Text, email, or straight into their CRM. Buyers bid above a floor you set, by lead type and by place, and the high bid wins. Caps and duplicate checks run on that pass.

Leads nobody takes go to a private marketplace. Fresh ones first, older ones after. A club then bills buyers every month for what's left. The industries they name are insurance, home services, legal, and real estate.

The legal name on the listing is Juiced Leads, LLC. It started in February 2024. The site shows a 5.0 on G2, and you can start a trial.
